validity_notes: AX_consistency threshold (0.6) is NOT TESTABLE from REUSED parent AX trees. Parent EXP-INTEL-35697055679 sampled 1 task per template family (10 tasks across 10 families), so within-family AX consistency (same intent_template -> same element pattern) cannot be directly verified. This is a measurement limitation, not a scientific falsification. PC1_WEB_SEARCH PASS and intent-to-element 5/5 PASS from parent support element-pattern consistency at the template description level.

Mind2Web dataset divergence: osunlp/Mind2Web has 73 websites/3 domains vs spec.json's stated 137 websites/31 domains. Overlap computed on actual dataset. This divergence is documented but does not invalidate the measurement.

Mind2Web shuffle null overlap (0.6942 mean) is high because the normalized operation-template clustering produces coarse mechanism labels (33 distinct train, 27 distinct test_website). The high null reflects the structural similarity of web tasks across sites. True overlap exceeds null mean by only 0.0466 (<0.10), failing the frozen threshold.

Mind2Web parameterization prevalence (0.6085) was computed from action_reprs parsing, not from the `actions` column which contains raw HTML. This is a measurement adaptation from the spec's original approach.
WebArena census matches parent EXP-INTEL-35697055679 measurements exactly (192/49/0.9479/0.0781/0.8958), confirming dataset integrity.
Playwright not installed in current environment; AX trees reused from parent per frozen measurement_validity clause 4. Below-fold/post-checkout AX patterns NOT measured.
Bootstrap CIs computed with 2000 reps, seed 35725763380. Shuffle null computed with 1000 permutations, same seed.
This experiment does NOT demonstrate LLM inheritance benefit, freshness, or repair. C-LLM-INHERIT remains EXPERIMENTAL pending future Product experiment on this substrate.
